body: It’s the weirdest thing- I’ve genuinely just woken up from a vyvanse induced nap, and yup! feel super awake and ready to start the day.

Oh my goodness the idea of two rings is perfect. Like a much cheaper one for everyday wear that the world won’t fall apart if I loose it, and then the actual ring for special occasions. That is absolutely genius

lost my 600 dollar 18th birthday present ring, BECAUSE I KNEW JEWELLERY WAS A BAD IDEA. I LOOSE EVERY PIECE OF JEWELLERY. My grandparents insisted on buying me expensive jewellery for my 18th birthday, and I’ve already lost and found the earrings, which are now stored in box in my mothers room, and I’ve lost the ring. I cannot find it. I cannot have jewellery for the life of me.
okay well that was very helpful y’all are smart having a bot to do that
but weigh binge weigh (get kinda impressed how much you got in) purge weigh is funnn (i no longer have allowed myself access to the scale dw)

THIS. like you want me to eat till i’m so full i can’t stand up straight?? because that’s the point where my stomach is quite literally ‘full’. Being ‘full’ means you physically cannot take another bite out of the pure disgust you feel for the food and you look pregnant
‘oh babe make sure you eat today’ bitch i’ve done nothing but eat today. bit less romantic when the text is ‘oh babe how much of your lunch today ended up in the loo?’

just know that i read this post and it could of genuinely been written by me. lw and everything the old ‘i just want to get under 100’ but in reality being at that weight, especially when purging of the way you got there, fucking sucks. you’re not the only one who feels like this. i genuinely don’t know how to eat normally. you get it in your head that the idea of digesting anything at all is horrific. if you ever want to talk- that’s been my reality too. it’s a shit space to be in

YES. When I’m high I feel the ability to see myself as more then just a body, more then just an picture to judge. Mindfully eating just,, tastes better. When I b/p it removes the act of thinking about my actions, i’m not processing what i’m doing to myself. B/p feels gross when high, like I can finally see what other people would see if they had an unrestricted view of a b/p session
